scripts.dev: concurrently -k --names "SYSTEM,WEB" --prefix-colors "cyan,green" "docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.api:docker:migrate: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec api sh -c "cd apps/api && npm run migrate:up"
scripts.api:docker:generate: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec api sh -c "cd apps/api && npm run prisma:generate"
scripts.api:docker:introspect: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec api sh -c "cd apps/api && npm run prisma:introspect"
scripts.api:docker:seed: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T api sh -c "cd apps/api && npm run db:seed"
